title: All The Love Is Mine
description: Executed in an expressive, raw style, this artwork features a glass snow globe resting on a vibrant yellow background. Rather than a defined winter scene, the sphere encloses fluid, abstract color stains alongside a red sketch of a solitary deer - evoking a sense of captured nostalgia and quiet inner states. Direct text is integrated into the composition: the phrase 'Sva ljubav je moja' (All the love is mine) is hand-written in charcoal above the globe, then heavily erased and crossed out with a bold black line. This gestural tension explores emotional irony, vulnerability, and the act of asserting then revoking personal affection, creating a powerful dialogic interaction between text, drawing, and color.
